tour.projectSettings: Configure workspace-level settings, including members, notifications, and integrations.
tour.channelList: Browse and manage all chat channels in this workspace. Pick a channel to open its conversation.
tour.issueList: Track tasks and issues. Select an issue to view its detail and workflow status.
tour.workfolder: Browse the workspace file tree and manage files. Opening a file switches to the Code Editor.
tour.codeEditor: Edit files here. The editor follows the active file from the Workfolder.
tour.chat: Channel conversation view. Messages from the selected channel show up here.
tour.issueDetail: Inspect an issue's description, members, and workflow execution in detail.
tour.terminal: Run shell commands inside the workspace's bound directories.
tour.gitCommits: Review git status, diffs, and commit history for the workspace.
tour.worktree: Manage git worktrees to work on multiple branches in parallel.
tour.activityLog: A live log of workspace activity and events.
